---
pagetitle: "Tifinagh Trainer"
description: "An interactive web app for learning to read and write the Tifinagh (ⵜⵉⴼⵉⵏⴰⵖ) script."
page-layout: full
comments: false
---

```{=html}
<iframe id="tifinagh-frame"
        src="assets/tifinagh-trainer.html"
        title="Tifinagh Trainer"
        scrolling="no"
        style="width:100%; border:0; display:block; height:85vh; background:#1E1C1A;"></iframe>
<script>
(function () {
  var frame = document.getElementById('tifinagh-frame');

  // space from the frame's top to the bottom of the window, so short content still
  // fills the screen while taller content makes the *page* (not the frame) scroll.
  function availableHeight() {
    var top = frame.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset;
    return Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - top);
  }

  function fit() {
    var doc = frame.contentWindow && frame.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc || !doc.body) return;
    var natural = Math.max(doc.body.scrollHeight, doc.body.offsetHeight);
    if (!natural) return;
    frame.style.height = Math.max(natural + 2, availableHeight()) + 'px';
  }

  frame.addEventListener('load', function () {
    var doc = frame.contentWindow && frame.contentWindow.document;
    if (!doc) return;
    // The trainer is built to fill 100% height (html,body,#dc-root all height:100%).
    // Relax that with !important so the body reports its real content height — then
    // we size the frame to it: no inner scrollbar, the page scrolls instead.
    var s = doc.createElement('style');
    s.textContent =
      'html,body{height:auto!important}' +
      '#dc-root,#dc-root .sc-host{height:auto!important;min-height:0!important}' +
      '#dc-root .sc-host>*{min-height:0!important}' +
      '[style*="min-height:100vh"],[style*="min-height: 100vh"]{min-height:0!important}';
    (doc.head || doc.documentElement).appendChild(s);

    if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(doc.body);
    fit();
    // React mounts async (loads from a CDN), so re-fit a few times as it settles.
    [60, 200, 600, 1500].forEach(function (t) { setTimeout(fit, t); });
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);
})();
</script>
```
